name: Stepped water-mill cascade (Barbegal type)
historical_period: 2nd c. CE (precedent); used here for a hypothetical 1000 CE city
license: original procedural geometry (TIMELINES Studio); materials use CC0 Poly Haven textures, see data/textures/LICENSES.json

historical_accuracy_notes: Two parallel rows of eight mill houses (v2: with windows and cornices) descending a slope with overshot wheels, fed by a branch of the aqueduct, after the Barbegal complex near Arles (2nd c. CE). Building sizes, wheel diameter (2.2 m) and step drop are estimates; mill machinery is not modelled.
references: Barbegal mill complex, Fontvieille near Arles (2nd c. CE)
Leveau, P. (1996) 'The Barbegal water mill in its environment', Journal of Roman Archaeology 9
